# Doberman Index

> Structured public registry connecting Doberman records, kennels, litters, pedigrees and bloodline relationships through stable record identifiers.

Canonical site: https://doberman-index.com/
Primary language: English
Public catalog: https://doberman-index.com/records/

## Canonical pages

- [Doberman Index](https://doberman-index.com/): registry portal and search entry point.
- [About](https://doberman-index.com/about.html): purpose, methodology, record types and evidence-first principles.
- [Published Records](https://doberman-index.com/records/): canonical catalog of published records.

## Record model

- DI-M / DI-F: individual Doberman records.
- DI-K: kennel records.
- DI-L: litter records linking kennel, sire, dam and indexed offspring.
- Stable record IDs persist as records are updated.
- Canonical record URLs use /records/DI-ID/.
- Published records distinguish recorded information from unavailable fields; publication does not imply that every field has independent documentary verification.

## Data and provenance

Doberman Index organizes submitted information and supporting material into a consistent public structure. Canonical record pages expose stable identifiers, update dates, relationships and machine-readable Dataset metadata. Source/evidence status belongs to the underlying record and should not be inferred beyond what the public record states.
